evidenceLayout: tmp/mod004/<planId>/ holds each plan's full command logs, each ending with an exit=<status> line. Each plan's Progress Log records every command, its exit status and its log path. Retries go under tmp/mod004/<planId>/attempt-<n>/. tmp/ is gitignored and must stay untracked. A missing or truncated log is not a pass.

executionModel.commitOwner: The orchestrator commits after the run with the AGENTS.md 1-6 section message and no Co-Authored-By or tool attribution line, and does not push. Workers never commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push or merge.
executionModel.retryPolicy: One plan in one wave, so no concurrent cargo contention is expected. If cargo reports a lock, wait about 60 s and retry, up to 10 times, then record a blocker in the plan's Progress Log.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record its sha256 and an intent snapshot in the Progress Log. If the file drifted, stop and report. After editing, record the post-edit sha256. Never edit outside writePaths.
executionModel.serialReconciliation: MOD004-40 owns crate-wide cargo fmt, the parent-plan, README and design status updates, the header Status lines of MOD004-20/21/22/30/40, and any recorded cross-plan repair.

designDecisionsAndRationale: Rate/block contract (design Implementation status): pair == legacy by to_bits at every rate/block/tier is mandatory; cross-block bitwise equality over frames [2048, 2048+8192) may become a recorded finding only when the legacy form shows the identical cross-block difference.
Orbit right-zero: OrbitDelay::run has no L/R cross-feed (src/dsp/bus.rs:557-567), so a right-zero stereo voice keeps R == 0.0 on the default bus.
Events are sample-accurate (src/dsp/engine.rs:717), so an absolute event time of 2048/rate starts the voice at frame 2048 for every block partition.
No archiving: the parent plan has MOD-005/006 pending, so all mod004-*.md stay in impl-plans/active/.
intentionalTradeoffs: Pre-MOD-004 block-partition dependence is recorded rather than fixed in engine code, and stays asserted as identical between pair and legacy.
In-body historical Status lines (mod004-00-baseline.md:191, mod004-20-select-lowering.md:281) stay untouched; only header line 3 changes.
